name: setup_status
description: Checklist of what is configured, missing or degraded. Call at the start of every run.

name: record_setup_decision
description: Record the user decision for an amber setup item (e.g. "no browser, accepted"), so setup can complete.

decision.description: The user's decision, in their words

name: start_run
description: Start a run and record detected capabilities (connectors, browser, local folder). Returns run_id.

capabilities.description: {connectors: {gmail, calendar, linkedin}, browser: "claude-in-chrome" | "built-in" | null, local_folder: bool}

name: finish_run
description: Close a run with a one-paragraph summary.

name: get_profile
description: All config sections: filters, prefs, writing, accounts, autonomy, schedule, sources, capabilities.

name: save_config
description: Validate and save one config section. Unknown fields are rejected. Field names and types are in templates/settings.example.yaml; an invalid call returns the section's expected fields.

section.description: filters | prefs | writing | accounts | autonomy | schedule | sources | capabilities

name: get_document
description: Read a user document: profile (CV distilled), stories, reusable-answers, voice.

name: save_document
description: Save a user document (markdown).

name: find_company
description: Dedupe check. Pass url when you have one: an exact URL or ATS posting, under any company and any recorded alias, is checked first and listed in exact_role_ids. Then fuzzy match on name, aliases, domain and ATS slug. verdict: new | seen | skip (live application, same posting, or no_cold_apply).

name: set_no_cold_apply
description: Mark a company as no_cold_apply (an intro or recruiter process is open), or clear it.

on.description: true to set, false to clear

name: add_alias
description: Add an alias to a company (brand, former name, parent) so dedupe catches it.

name: upsert_role
description: Create or update a role (creates the company if needed). Pass id to update a known role. Otherwise a role is matched on its exact URL or ATS posting, never on title: with no match a new role starts as found, and possible_role_ids lists same-title roles at the company to rule out before scoring. A URL matching several roles returns an error naming them and writes nothing. Returns the dedupe result for new roles.

company.description: Company name as the employer writes it

company_aliases.description: Other names, e.g. a brand vs the legal entity

url_aliases.description: Other URLs for this same posting, e.g. the LinkedIn card of an Ashby job. Needs identity_evidence

identity_evidence.description: Required with url_aliases: how you confirmed the listings are one posting

ats.description: ashby | greenhouse | lever | workable | teamtailor | personio | join | workday | other

location_line.description: Verbatim location line from the employer ATS

industry.description: Industry of the business line the role sits in

name: get_role
description: Role with its company, full event history, artifacts, interviews, and the urls and ATS postings it is known by.

name: transition
description: Move a role through found → verified → scored → queued → applied → interviewing → offer (dropped from found/verified/scored/queued; closed from queued/applied/interviewing/offer). Rejects illegal moves. verified needs evidence (URL + verbatim location line), location_line and location_type. dropped needs evidence (quote or rule:<id>). applied needs the confirmation text. closed needs outcome.

to.description: found | verified | scored | queued | applied | interviewing | offer | dropped | closed

evidence.description: Verbatim quote with URL, rule:<id>, or confirmation text

category.description: For drops: location | pay | industry | role_shape | stack | culture | duplicate | gated | other

question.description: For queued: the single blocking question for the user

blocked_by.description: For queued: browser | user | login | captcha | other

location_line.description: verified only: verbatim from the ATS

location_type.description: verified only: remote | hybrid | onsite | unknown

score_notes.description: scored only: short notes, including gaps kept internal

name: record
description: Append a validated event without the state-machine check: outcomes from outside (rejection, invite, user decision) or a note (omit status).

status.description: found | verified | scored | queued | applied | interviewing | offer | dropped | closed (omit for a note)

question.description: Blocking question for the user (shown under Needs you until a later event)

name: check_pay
description: Deterministic pay-floor check. Drops only if the band maximum is below the floor; straddling bands are kept and flagged. Pass fx_rate when the currency differs from the floor (look it up, never guess).

fx_rate.description: Floor-currency units per 1 unit of currency

name: gate_check
description: Pre-submit check: role verified, dedupe clean, not no_cold_apply, no live application at the company.

name: add_artifact
description: Save a cover note, PDF, Gmail draft id, form answers, confirmation or note. Prose is linted. gmail_draft stays unverified until verify_artifact.

role_id.description: Role id (omit for drafts not tied to a role)

kind.description: cover_note | cover_letter_pdf | gmail_draft | form_answers | confirmation | note

ref.description: Path, URL or Gmail draft id

name: list_artifacts
description: Artifacts for a run, a local day or a role, with lint results and read-back state. The auditor uses this.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day in filters.timezone (ignored when run_id is given)

name: verify_artifact
description: Mark an artifact verified after reading it back. For gmail_draft, readback must be the get_draft/list_drafts output containing the draft id.

name: lint_prose
description: Lint outbound prose: em/en dashes, "not X but Y", fake-candid openers, volunteered gaps, length.

name: open_items
description: Queue (fresh and stale), unverified drafts, interviews to book, upcoming interviews.

stale_after_days.description: Queue items untouched this long are listed as stale (default 14)

name: pipeline_summary
description: Counts by status, live processes, rejections, queue (fresh and stale).

name: open_board
description: Start the local kanban board (or reuse the running one). With open: true it opens in the user's browser and the link is not returned; otherwise the link is returned. The user drags cards to move roles; moves follow transition's rules and are recorded as the user's. The board stops after 30 idle minutes.

open.description: true also opens it in the default browser. Only when the user asked to see the board now; never in a scheduled run.

name: add_rule
description: Add a user preference or correction as a rule, with reason and example.

reason.description: Why (the incident or the user words)

name: list_rules
description: Active rules with provenance.

name: deactivate_rule
description: Deactivate a rule.

name: source_health
description: Per-source status, consecutive failures, yield.

name: set_source_status
description: Record a source result for this run. Three consecutive failures mark it degraded.

name: add_interview
description: Record an interview (or a booking link still to book: omit starts_at). Moves the role to interviewing.

starts_at.description: ISO datetime, omit if not booked yet

name: render_report
description: Markdown daily report. With run_id it covers that run; otherwise the local day. Lead with the outcome via headline. Only read-back drafts and confirmed submissions are claimed.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day in filters.timezone (report title; ignored for scope when run_id is given)

headline.description: One or two sentences: the outcome

name: audit
description: Post-run rule check for a run (preferred) or a local day: excluded industries, drops without evidence, applied without confirmation, prose lint, drafts not read back, no_cold_apply. Pass run_id or date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a day in filters.timezone (ignored when run_id is given)

name: import_legacy
description: One-off import of the manual pipeline: applied-log.md, outreach-preferences.md, queue/*.md, and user documents. Pass the contents, or path to a local pipeline/ folder.

path.description: Local path to the pipeline/ folder
